description: Open-web searches were performed in French and English across all four February weekly windows and targeted education, university, labor, transport, regional and political terms. Search results were noisy and often ignored year filters; multiple apparent February leads proved to be from 2021, May 2023 or February 2024. This does not establish that no other protest occurred.
required_followup: Review additional contemporaneous local archives and official/rights reporting if available; no systematic LexisNexis or equivalent archive coverage was available in this pass.

description: Searches covered French and English, and local outlets surfaced Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and other regional references, but no systematic Lingala or Kituba search was conducted. Exact region/sector coverage outside search hits remains unknown.
required_followup: If feasible in a later coverage review, search local-language sources and regional press for Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire, Loutété/Niari and other departments; do not infer absence from current results.

description: The ACI exact URL surfaced as a potentially related university strike item, but one exact-URL tool open returned an internal fetch timeout. It is a technical retrieval failure, not an observed publisher denial; its search snippet appears to refer to a different 2025–26 strike and was not used for February 2023 coding.
required_followup: No retry was made. If future in-scope evidence is required, use another permitted source or an ordinary exact URL request only after a fresh access assessment; do not treat the timeout as a denial.

description: Official baseline and equivalent systematic newspaper-archive coverage remain open coordinator gates. Open web search is not LexisNexis and no exhaustive-coverage claim is made.
required_followup: Coordinator to resolve the official baseline and applicable archive access outside this researcher’s unit.
